title: Faithful IEC serial electrical model with native parity
body: CIA2 reads the live open-collector IEC bus through the C64 inverting buffers; idle DATA-low is supplied by the true-drive 1541 holding DATA. C64GS (no IEC) keeps disconnected->low. Idle reads match native ($47 normal C64 / $07 C64GS) and native CIA2-IO lockstep stays green.
